The exact method used by Slingshot to exploit the routers in the first instance is not yet clear. When the target user runs Winbox Loader software (a utility used for Mikrotik router configuration), this connects to the router and downloads some DLLs (dynamic link libraries) from the router’s file system.

While for most victims the infection vector for Slingshot remains unknown, we were able to find several cases where the attackers got access to Mikrotik routers and placed a component downloaded by Winbox Loader, a management suite for Mikrotik routers.

pipeline.attack_summary: An attacker uses phishing emails containing hyperlinks to deliver a NetWire RAT variant via MediaFire. The initial payload is a 7z archive that decompresses into an EXE file named 'PROFORMA-INVOICE 0990.exe'. This malware employs anti-analysis techniques such as dynamic code extraction and mouse movement detection for sandbox evasion. It establishes persistence through registry keys, collects system information, logs keystrokes, and communicates with a C2 server at gbam0001.duckdns.org:3366 using command '9B' to send victim details. The malware supports over 80 commands including credential theft, file operations, process control, and network endpoint enumeration.

We review the infection chain of events, examine the associated network traffic, and cover post-infection artifacts from an infected Windows host. This material is primarily helpful to Security Operations Center (SOC) personnel like front-line analysts and people who perform forensic investigations.

description: Detects unauthenticated exploitation of CVE-2023-22518 in Confluence Data Center and Server via /json/setup-restore.action endpoint with X-Atlassian-Token: no-check header and multipart form data containing a .zip file.
references:

    service: webserver

    selection_uri:

    selection_header:
        cs-header: X-Atlassian-Token: no-check
    selection_content_type:

level: critical

attack_vector.reasoning: The write-up clearly describes an unauthenticated XSS vulnerability in the login redirection endpoint with a JavaScript payload that can be injected via the redir parameter. The PoC shows direct URL manipulation and the use of encoded JavaScript, making this a clear initial access vector.

pipeline.attack_summary: An attacker exploits multiple vulnerabilities in Fortigate SSL VPN including pre-auth file reading (CVE-2018-13379), XSS (CVE-2018-13380), and heap overflows (CVE-2018-13381, CVE-2018-13383) to gain unauthorized access and execute arbitrary code. The attack chain begins with an unauthenticated XSS via the /remote/loginredir endpoint, followed by exploitation of a heap overflow in WebVPN to achieve remote code execution through a crafted SSL structure manipulation.

pipeline.attack_summary: The Epic Turla campaign uses spearphishing emails with malicious PDF or .SCR attachments to initially compromise victims, exploiting CVE-2013-3346 and CVE-2013-5065 vulnerabilities. Attackers also use watering hole techniques targeting specific websites like those of government institutions in Romania and Spain, leveraging Java and Flash exploits (CVE-2012-1723). Once inside, they deploy the Tavdig backdoor, which communicates via HTTP to C&Cs, later upgrading to more advanced Carbon/Cobra systems for lateral movement and persistence.

title: Initial Access - Unauthenticated Command Injection via GlobalProtect SESSID Cookie
id: 5a8b7c9d-1e2f-4a5b-8c9d-1e2f4a5b8c9d
status: experimental
description: Detects initial access attempt using unauthenticated HTTP POST to /global-protect/login.esp with crafted SESSID cookie containing directory traversal and command injection payload.
references:
    - https://security.paloaltonetworks.com/CVE-2024-3400
    - https://labs.watchtowr.com/palo-alto-putting-the-protecc-in-globalprotect-cve-2024-3400/
    - https://attackerkb.com/topics/SSTk336Tmf/cve-2024-3400/rapid7-analysis
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1210/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1210
logsource:
    category: webserver
    product: nginx
detection:
    selection:
        cs-method: POST
        cs-uri-query: /global-protect/login.esp
        cs-cookie|contains: SESSID=
    filter:
        cs-cookie|regex: SESSID=.*\.{2}\/.*
    condition: selection and not filter
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative tools using SESSID cookie for authentication
level: high

pipeline.attack_summary: Raspberry Robin is a worm that initially spread via infected USB drives containing disguised LNK files or autorun.inf configurations. It uses living-off-the-land binaries (LOLBins) like rundll32.exe, msiexec.exe, and regsvr32.exe to execute payloads and establish persistence through registry keys such as RunOnce and UserAssist. The malware evolved to deploy other malware families including FakeUpdates, IcedID, Bumblebee, and TrueBot, often leading to ransomware activity via actors like DEV-0243 (EvilCorp) and DEV-0950 (FIN11/TA505). It leverages cloud services for delivery and employs techniques such as disabling Windows Defender scanning to evade detection.

Credential dumping was performed using Mimikatz, followed by lateral movement using tools like Remcom and Ligolo tunneling.

title: Potential Atlassian Confluence CVE-2021-26084 Exploitation Attempt
rules_yaml:
title: Initial Access via Unauthenticated Confluence OGNL Injection
id: 5a7b4c8d-9e2f-4a1b-8c3d-0e5f6a7b8c9d
status: stable
description: 'Detects unauthenticated HTTP GET requests to Confluence''s vulnerable createpage-entervariables.action endpoint with crafted OGNL expressions in query parameters, indicating exploitation of CVE-2021-26084.'
references:
    - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2021-26084
    - https://confluence.atlassian.com/doc/confluence-security-advisory-2021-08-25-1077906215.html
    - https://github.com/h3v0x/CVE-2021-26084_Confluence
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1213/001/
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1588/006/
author: Sigma Assistant
date: 2026-09-24
tags:
    - attack.initial_access
    - attack.t1190
    - cve.2021.26084
logsource:
    category: webserver
    product: apache
    service: httpd
detection:
    selection_1:
        cs-method: GET
        cs-uri-stem: /pages/createpage-entervariables.action
    selection_2:
        cs-uri-query|contains: '${'
    selection_3:
        cs-uri-query|contains: 'SpaceKey='
    condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative queries using the same endpoint with valid parameters
level: high

This vulnerability affects versions before 6.13.23, from 6.14.0 before 7.4.11, from 7.5.0 before 7.11.6, and from 7.12.0 before 7.12.5.
